topic: the turn-cap horizon and the one board divergence it was hiding

predictions.claim: At --turns 50 on the same pins, end_reasons has NO row 'the turn cap (50)' (0 games truncated).
predictions.why: the parent reported 958 of 961 ended naturally at cap 50.

predictions.claim: At --turns 50 the bar (state.games less state.games_board_never_diverged) reads 1 of 958.

The 1-vs-4 gap is EXACTLY the void exclusion: endStateSummary is called on a.results UNFILTERED (game_differential.js:7509) while the bar filters out _mid_void games (7861). Under --state-count-void at cap 50 the bar will read 4 of 961.
predictions.why: 3 void-excluded games at cap 20 already account for by_cause reading 3 while the bar reads 0.

predictions.claim: The single non-void board divergence at cap 50 first parts at a turn STRICTLY GREATER THAN 20.
predictions.why: it is invisible at cap 20 by construction.

predictions.claim: At --turns 100 every published block (end_reasons, state, by_cause_totals, first_divergences) is identical to the cap-50 run except turns_cap itself.
predictions.why: if no game is truncated at 50, a larger cap cannot change any game's play under fixed seeds.

predictions.claim: Cost from cap 20 to cap 50 is under 25% more wall-clock.
predictions.why: only 35 of 961 games were still running at turn 20.
